title: The Empty Cart
hook: They stole the cart and left the gold.
delivery: Liam only; confident temptation turns to embarrassed recognition and decisive escape
description:
Jason has spent their escape money on ten gold bars. Lucia is staring at an empty cart, two deep scratches, and a shutter that has started to close.

story_audit.goal: Recover real gold after Jason spends their escape money on a fraudulent deal.
story_audit.stakes: Their entire escape fund and Jason's signed evidence of purchase are in hostile hands.
story_audit.obstacle: The seller locks them inside while Jason argues about his money; real bars hidden in heavy cart base.
story_audit.planted_clue: Loaded cart has no gouges; apparently empty cart cuts deep matching tracks into painted floor.
story_audit.payoff: They use decoys to jam shutter and lever open heavy cart, recovering real gold plus incriminating signed receipt.
story_audit.causal_check: Wear marks point to concealed weight, hand test confirms decoys; shutter creates deadline and useful obstacle; real fortune is stolen with damage and cash lost, while Jason cedes control of future deals. Explicit 70cm clearance for 35cm cart and crawling adults; nobody walks upright through barrier. Seller behind wired-glass booth cannot simply step over and remove jam immediately.

canon_status: Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos are GTA VI characters in fan-art adaptation. The Fixer is an original supporting character. All plots, jobs, props, businesses and scene-specific sets here are invented noncanon fan fiction.
script: Jason spent their escape money buying ten gold bars. Lucia wanted to steal the empty cart. He thought she was angry. She pointed at the floor: the loaded cart left no marks. The empty one had gouged two tracks through the shed's green paint toward the exit. Jason lifted a bar. Too light. The seller had parked the real weight inside the other cart's base. He wanted his money back. Lucia watched the shutter descend. Asking politely would cost them their exit. She shoved the fake bars beneath the shutter. Jason tipped the heavy cart until its false bottom split. Gold hit concrete. So did the receipt bearing Jason's signature. Lucia made him pick that up first. They rolled out under the jammed shutter. Jason got his fortune. Lucia got control of the next deal.
